policy.trigger: When an assistant/operator-authored MCP change causes a severe recurring regression, or the user explicitly reports the previously working MCP regressed after our change and requests restoration, restore the frozen local behavior/topology before speculative fixes.
required_order: Preserve the current runtime, OAuth stores, active work, live transport evidence, and rollback artifacts.
Use the production change gate and exact Busy scope before serving-path mutation.
If only routing differs, restore only the Caddy route; do not restart or kill a backend that already matches the selected artifact.
Restore stable to 3022 and pr237 to 3027 through the frozen graceful route-switch script when rollback is required.
Do not restore OAuth backups automatically; compare current store identity and token rotation first.
Verify public Host handling, OAuth/tool contract, exact five-tool profile, original-image resource behavior, and backend health after restore.
policy.preservation_rule: preserve unique work and active child processes; do not kill foreign or rollback work to accelerate recovery.
policy.authorization_rule: Routine reversible shared-production restoration or serving advance that is already the established scoped objective is authorized by go/continue once the existing production-change safety gates pass; do not ask for redundant per-cutover approval. Separate explicit user authorization remains required for scope-widening, destructive overwrite of user/foreign state, scheduler/fleet mutation, credential/permission changes, or shared production topology/control-plane redesign.
recovery_invariants: keep the selected recovery target fixed during an active incident unless new evidence positively disqualifies it.
Before any serving-path mutation reconcile live backend commit/generation, current Caddy routes, active callers, OAuth store identity, and an independent rollback path.
Instance/task names and labels such as test/debug are never proof that a route is disposable.
If the backend artifact already matches the selected recovery artifact and only topology differs, restore only topology.
Never merge the stable and pr237 OAuth stores or overwrite a live store from backup without proving that token rotation will not be lost.
Image acceptance requires the exact original resource bytes; a thumbnail-only result is a regression.
